items.title: Urban Transportation Economics
items.model: The lecture discussed the problem of congestion in large cities and proposed digital congestion pricing as a solution. By charging drivers more during peak hours, people are encouraged to use public transport, which reduces delays. The speaker also noted that the revenue generated can be reinvested in roads, rail services, and cycle networks, creating a self-funding improvement cycle.
items.audio: Urban transport systems in large cities often reach their capacity limits, leading to severe bottlenecks during peak commute hours. For decades, city planners relied on expanding roadways to alleviate congestion, but this approach often induces more demand, ultimately worsening the problem. One highly effective modern response is the implementation of digital congestion pricing, which charges drivers a premium to enter specific zones during high-traffic periods. This economic lever not only encourages commuters to utilize public transport or adopt carpooling, but it also significantly reduces emissions in dense metropolitan centers. Furthermore, the substantial revenue generated from these tolls can be strategically reinvested into municipal infrastructure. Cities that have adopted this model have successfully funded extensive expansions of their light rail services, improved pedestrian walkways, and established dedicated cycle networks. Consequently, shifting the financial burden onto private vehicle usage creates a sustainable cycle that promotes cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable urban mobility.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
items.model: Artificial intelligence has already demonstrated remarkable accuracy in detecting conditions such as skin cancer and diabetic retinopathy, which has led some commentators to predict that human doctors will soon be redundant. While AI will undoubtedly assume a growing share of diagnostic work, I disagree that it will replace clinicians entirely, because medicine depends on judgement under uncertainty, empathetic communication and ethical accountability that machines cannot presently replicate. To begin with, algorithmic diagnosis excels where datasets are large and patterns are stable. Radiological screening and pathology slide analysis are cases in which software consistently matches or exceeds average human performance, and hospitals that adopt such tools report faster turnaround times and fewer oversight errors. It is therefore sensible to delegate narrow, repetitive interpretation tasks to machines. However, treatment decisions rarely reduce to pattern recognition. A patient presenting with chest pain may have an atypical history, financial constraints or anxiety that colours the clinical picture; weighing these factors requires conversation and trust. Moreover, when an algorithm errs, responsibility must rest with an identifiable professional, whereas an opaque model cannot be held accountable in any meaningful sense. In conclusion, artificial intelligence will transform medicine rather than replace physicians, taking over high-volume diagnostic tasks while leaving holistic judgement, empathy and accountability in human hands. Medical schools should therefore teach students to collaborate with these systems rather than compete against them.

items.title: Remote Working and the Urban Economy
items.model: The rapid shift to remote working that began during the pandemic has become a permanent feature of the labour market, and its consequences extend well beyond the individual desk. This essay discusses the principal advantages and disadvantages of the trend for both employers and employees. On the positive side, companies no longer need to fund extensive office space, and they can recruit talent regardless of geography. Employees, for their part, reclaim the hours previously spent commuting and often report a better work-life balance. These gains help organisations retain experienced staff in what remains a fiercely competitive labour market. Nevertheless, the disadvantages are significant and should not be minimised. Junior workers lose the informal mentoring that a shared office provides almost accidentally, and collaboration on complex projects becomes harder when every conversation must be scheduled in advance. Employers also face genuine difficulties in monitoring productivity and in preserving a coherent company culture across geographically scattered teams. Commercial property illustrates the wider economic effect: city centres that once depended on office workers now contend with vacant towers, sharply reduced footfall for nearby cafes and shops, and a narrowing municipal tax base that ultimately constrains public services. In conclusion, while remote working delivers substantial flexibility and measurable savings for employers and staff alike, it weakens informal training, erodes company culture and hollows out urban economies, so a deliberate hybrid model that balances both sides remains the most sustainable long-term outcome for every stakeholder involved.
items.prompt: Remote working arrangements have permanently altered corporate structure and commercial real estate. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend for both employers and employees.

items.title: The Sharing Economy

en.0: Supported directly: "derive their profitability from taking a commission on every transaction".
en.1: Supported: "providers bear the costs of insurance, maintenance and downtime".
en.3: Supported: "lowers barriers to entry and gives people a flexible source of income".
en.4: Not stated anywhere in the passage.

items.text: The sharing economy is frequently presented as a frictionless exchange between individuals, yet the reality is more complicated. Platforms such as ride-hailing and short-lease marketplaces derive their profitability from taking a commission on every transaction, which means their interests are aligned with maximising volume rather than with the welfare of providers. Regulators have responded unevenly: some cities license operators strictly, while others have allowed them to expand before establishing any framework. Critics argue that because providers bear the costs of insurance, maintenance and downtime, the arrangement effectively transfers commercial risk from a well-funded corporation to an individual worker. Supporters counter that the model lowers barriers to entry and gives people a flexible source of income that traditional employment cannot offer.
items.question: Read the passage and choose THREE correct options. Wrong answers incur a negative penalty, so select only what the text supports.
options: Platforms earn commission on transactions, so they benefit from higher volume.
Providers in the sharing economy carry costs such as insurance and maintenance.
All cities regulate ride-hailing operators under an identical legal framework.
Supporters argue the model offers flexible income and lower barriers to entry.
The passage states that ride-hailing has eliminated conventional taxi services entirely.

zh.p: 细节匹配 + 排除绝对化选项（多选会倒扣分）
zh.a: 选 A、B、D。A 对应第 2 句 "derive their profitability from taking a commission on every transaction"，所以平台想要更多交易量；B 对应 "providers bear the costs of insurance, maintenance and downtime"；D 对应最后一句支持者观点 "lowers barriers to entry ... flexible source of income"。
o: 正确：commission on every transaction → maximising volume，原文同义改写。
正确：bear the costs of insurance, maintenance = carry costs。
错误：原文说 Regulators have responded unevenly（各地不一样），identical 与原文相反。
正确：支持者观点，原文几乎逐词对应。
错误：原文完全没提出租车被淘汰，eliminated ... entirely 是典型的“无中生有 + 绝对化”。
zh.t: 看到 all / entirely / always / only 这类绝对词先打问号；只选原文能逐句找到依据的选项，没把握的不选（错一个倒扣 1 分）。

items.title: Discovery of Penicillin

en.logic: Discovery (A) prompts the observation (B), which leads to isolation of the compound (C), and only then to wartime mass production (D).

paras: In 1928, Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin by accident when a mould contaminated a culture plate.
He noticed that the mould prevented the normal growth of staphylococci bacteria around it.
Subsequent isolation of the active chemical ingredient revolutionised modern clinical medicine.
Mass production during the Second World War saved millions of wounded soldiers from bacterial infection.

zh.p: 时间顺序 + 代词指代
zh.a: 顺序 A → B → C → D。A 有具体年份和完整主语 Alexander Fleming，是开头句；B 的 He 和 the mould 都指向 A；C 的 Subsequent（随后）说明在发现之后；D 的 Mass production during the Second World War 时间最晚。
o: A：完整人名 + 年份，独立成句，开头。
B：He / the mould 回指 A。
C：Subsequent isolation 承接“发现”之后的下一步。
D：二战时期量产，时间线最后。
zh.t: 先找没有代词（he/this/these）、没有连接词（however/then）的句子当开头；再两两配对：代词必须紧跟它指代的那句。

items.title: Photosynthesis and Light

en.logic: The process opens with sunlight striking the leaf (C), then absorption by chlorophyll (A), then conversion into glucose (D), and closes with the consequence of insufficient light (B).

paras: Chlorophyll in the leaf absorbs this energy and converts it into chemical energy.
Without sufficient light the reaction slows, which is why plants grown in darkness etiolate.
Photosynthesis begins when sunlight strikes the surface of a leaf.
The chemical energy is then used to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen.

zh.p: 过程顺序 + 指示词 this
zh.a: 顺序 C → A → D → B。C 用 begins 引出过程，是开头；A 的 this energy 指 C 里的 sunlight；D 的 The chemical energy is then used 承接 A 的 chemical energy；B 讲光照不足的后果，是收尾。
o: A：this energy 回指 C 的 sunlight，紧跟 C。
B：Without sufficient light 是对整个过程的补充/结论，放最后。
C：Photosynthesis begins，开头。
D：The chemical energy ... then，承接 A。
zh.t: 过程类题目抓 begins / then / finally 这些信号词；同一个名词第一次出现用 a/完整说法，再次出现用 the/this。

items.title: Urban Farming

en.0: Too extreme; the writer says the gap is narrowing.
en.1: Opposite of the text — the ninety-five percent figure is presented as fact.
en.2: The writer concedes the energy problem but concludes the "true value ... lies not in calories but in resilience".
en.3: Contradicted by "can exceed", which allows indoor crops to win in clean-energy regions.

items.text: Vertical farming — the practice of growing crops in stacked indoor layers — is often lauded for using ninety-five percent less water than conventional agriculture. Yet the enthusiasm overlooks a decisive constraint: the energy required to replace sunlight with artificial lighting. In regions where electricity is generated largely from coal, the carbon footprint of a vertically farmed lettuce can exceed that of one trucked from a distant field. Proponents respond that falling photovoltaic costs and LED efficiency are steadily narrowing this gap, and that the true value of indoor farming lies not in calories but in resilience, since crops grow unaffected by drought and flood.
items.question: Read the passage and choose the ONE option that best answers the question: What is the writer’s main argument?
options: Vertical farming should be abandoned because it consumes too much electricity.
The water savings of vertical farming are exaggerated by its supporters.
Vertical farming’s worth should be judged by food security rather than by calorie cost alone.
Trucked vegetables will always have a smaller carbon footprint than indoor crops.

zh.p: 主旨题：让步 + 转折后的作者结论
zh.a: 选 C。文章先承认节水优势，再用 Yet 指出能耗问题，最后落在 "the true value of indoor farming lies not in calories but in resilience"（真正价值在于抗灾的韧性，即粮食安全）。C 的 food security rather than calorie cost 正好是这句的同义改写。
o: 错误：过度推断。作者说差距在缩小（narrowing this gap），没有说应该放弃。
错误：95% 节水是作为事实陈述的，作者没说被夸大。
正确：not in calories but in resilience 的同义改写。
错误：原文是 can exceed（可能超过），always 是绝对化。
zh.t: 主旨题重点看 Yet / However 之后和最后一句；带 should be abandoned、always 的选项通常太绝对。

items.title: Renewable Energy Costs
segs: Over the past decade the levelised cost of solar photovoltaics has fallen dramatically, making renewables the cheapest source of new electricity in most of the world. Advances in manufacturing and economies of scale have driven panel prices down, while improved
has increased the amount of energy each panel produces. Governments continue to offer tax
to encourage households to install capacity, and ageing coal plants are being
earlier than originally scheduled because they can no longer compete on price.

zh.p: 搭配 + 词性 + 上下文逻辑
zh.a: efficiency / incentives / decommissioned。
o: improved ___ has increased the amount of energy each panel produces：improved 后接名词，“让每块板发电更多”的是效率 efficiency。inflation（通胀）语义不通。
tax ___ to encourage households：鼓励安装的是“税收优惠” tax incentives，固定搭配。tariffs（关税）是惩罚性的，与 encourage 矛盾。
ageing coal plants are being ___ earlier：被动语态需要过去分词，“提前退役” decommissioned。obsolete 是形容词，不能放在 being 后表被动动作。
zh.t: 先判断空格词性（被动 being + 过去分词、improved + 名词），再看搭配（tax incentives），最后用句意验证。

into rivers or soaks into the ground to become groundwater. A portion of this water is
by plants and released again through their leaves, a process that links the terrestrial cycle directly to the
one.

zh.p: 主谓一致 + 专业搭配
zh.a: flows / transpired / atmospheric。
o: it either ___ into rivers or soaks into the ground：与 soaks 并列，需要第三人称单数动词，flows into rivers。condenses 已在前文描述云的形成，这里是落地后的流动。
A portion of this water is ___ by plants and released again through their leaves：植物吸收后经叶片释放，是“蒸腾” transpired；被动 is + 过去分词。
links the terrestrial cycle directly to the ___ one：terrestrial（陆地的）对应 atmospheric（大气的），one 指 cycle，需要形容词。
zh.t: either A or B 两边结构要平行；the ___ one 里的空一定是形容词。

items.title: Antibiotic Development
segs: Pharmaceutical companies have largely abandoned antibiotic research because the financial returns are unattractive. A newly developed drug may be held in
as a last resort, meaning it is rarely prescribed and therefore generates little revenue. Meanwhile resistance continues to spread,
the effectiveness of existing treatments. Some economists propose that governments should offer
payments or market-entry rewards to make the development of new antimicrobials commercially viable once again.

zh.p: 固定搭配 + 现在分词作状语
zh.a: reserve / eroding / guaranteed。
o: be held in reserve：固定搭配“留作储备”，后面 as a last resort 呼应。storage 不和 held in 搭配表达这个意思。
resistance continues to spread, ___ the effectiveness：逗号后用现在分词作结果状语，耐药性扩散会“削弱”疗效 eroding。improving 方向相反。
offer ___ payments：为了让研发“重新有商业价值”，需要“有保障的付款” guaranteed payments。penalties（罚款）与目的相反。
zh.t: 逗号 + 空格 + 名词，常常是 -ing 结果状语；先判断正负方向再选词。

items.title: Language Acquisition
segs: Children acquire language with remarkable speed, and by the age of five most speakers command several thousand words. They do this not by memorising definitions but by
patterns from the speech they hear around them. Exposure to varied vocabulary is essential: studies show that children who hear a wider range of words develop a larger
earlier, which in turn predicts later reading ability. This is why early
programmes have such a lasting effect on educational outcomes.

zh.p: 介词后动名词 + 近义词辨析
zh.a: inferring / lexicon / intervention。
o: not by memorising ... but by ___ patterns：not by A but by B 结构平行，memorising 对应 inferring（推断出规律）。forgetting 意思相反。
develop a larger ___ earlier：与 vocabulary 语义相同的名词 lexicon（词汇量）。grammar 不能说 larger。
early ___ programmes：教育学固定搭配 early intervention programmes（早期干预项目）。punishment 语义不符。
zh.t: not by A but by B 两边词性一致；early intervention 是教育/医学类文章高频搭配，值得记住。

items.title: Deep Ocean Exploration
segs: Hydrothermal vents on the ocean floor support unique ecosystems that thrive in the absence of sunlight. Instead of photosynthesis, organisms in these extreme habitats rely on
, converting chemical compounds dissolved in thermal water into organic energy. Studying these extremophiles offers valuable insights into the potential for life on other
in the solar system.

zh.p: 对比逻辑 Instead of + 学科词
zh.a: chemosynthesis / planets。
o: Instead of photosynthesis, organisms ... rely on ___, converting chemical compounds：不用光合作用，而是靠化学物质产能，即“化能合成” chemosynthesis。respiration（呼吸作用）不是能量来源的替代。
life on other ___ in the solar system：太阳系里的其他“行星” planets。comets（彗星）一般不讨论生命存在。
zh.t: Instead of X 后面的答案一定和 X 是同类但相反的概念；看到 converting chemical compounds 直接定位 chemo-。

items.title: Solar Power
segs: Advances in renewable energy technology have significantly
the cost of solar power generation. Over the past decade, solar panels have become far more
, allowing household consumers and industrial facilities to transition towards sustainable power grids. Governments worldwide continue to provide tax
to accelerate adoption.

zh.p: 语义方向判断
zh.a: reduced / efficient / incentives。
o: Advances ... have significantly ___ the cost：技术进步让成本“降低”，reduced。increased 与“进步”方向相反。
become far more ___, allowing ... to transition towards sustainable grids：能推动转型的是“更高效” efficient；costly、obsolete 是负面词。
provide tax ___ to accelerate adoption：加速普及的是“税收优惠” incentives。penalties、barriers 会阻碍普及。
zh.t: 这类题先看整句是正面还是负面语境，四个选项通常只有一个方向对。

zh.p: 学科搭配 + 逻辑对比 not ... not
zh.a: consolidates / transfers / reduce。
o: the brain ___ the day's learning into lasting memory：“把学到的内容巩固成长期记忆”，consolidate ... into memory 是心理学固定搭配。discards（丢弃）方向相反。

segs: Annual reports were originally designed to
shareholders on the financial health of a company. In practice, modern disclosures are so lengthy that few investors read them, and the most important figures are often
within hundreds of pages of boilerplate text. Regulators have therefore begun to
the information that firms must present prominently.

zh.p: 目的 + 隐喻用法
zh.a: inform / buried / simplify。
o: designed to ___ shareholders on the financial health：inform sb on/about sth，向股东“告知”。deceive 不会是设计初衷。
the most important figures are often ___ within hundreds of pages：重要数字被“埋没”在几百页套话里，buried within 是常见隐喻。
Regulators have therefore begun to ___ the information：therefore 承接“太长没人读”，所以要“简化” simplify。
zh.t: therefore 后面是前文问题的解决办法；inform sb on/of/about 是高频搭配。

items.title: Coral Spawning
segs: Once a year, corals mass-spawn in a spectacular display that
a once-a-year opportunity for fertilisation. Because the larvae must settle before being swept away,
timing is critical; a shift of only a few days can leave newly settled coral in unsuitable conditions. Warming seas have begun to
this delicate synchrony, threatening recovery efforts.

zh.p: 动词语义 + 形容词修饰
zh.a: represents / precise / disrupt。
o: a spectacular display that ___ a once-a-year opportunity：这次产卵“代表/构成”一年一次的受精机会，represents。destroys 与 opportunity 矛盾。
___ timing is critical; a shift of only a few days can leave ...：几天偏差就有影响，说明要“精确的” precise timing。

items.title: Biodiversity Loss
items.model: Biodiversity loss is accelerating because of deforestation, habitat fragmentation and climate disruption, which destroy habitat, isolate populations and shift seasonal breeding cues; scientists stress that extinctions weaken the ecological networks that purify water, pollinate crops and regulate disease, so preserving and reconnecting habitats is vital for wildlife and human food security alike.
items.audio: Biodiversity loss is currently accelerating across every major global ecosystem at unprecedented rates. Historically, mass extinctions were driven by massive geological or astronomical events, but the current crisis is distinctly anthropogenic. The primary drivers include widespread deforestation, which obliterates entire habitats overnight; habitat fragmentation, which isolates fragile animal populations and severely reduces their genetic diversity; and the looming shadow of climate disruption, which drastically alters the seasonal and temperature cues that countless species rely on for crucial breeding and migration cycles. When we talk about this loss, it is vital to understand the cascading effects. Scientists warn that losing individual species does not simply remove an organism from a checklist; it fundamentally weakens the intricate, interconnected ecological networks that our societies depend upon. These networks perform indispensable services that we often take for granted, such as naturally purifying our fresh water sources, pollinating agricultural crops, and even regulating the emergence of infectious diseases. If the foundation of these ecosystems collapses, the economic and health repercussions for human civilization will be profound. Therefore, implementing aggressive conservation policies, coupled with initiatives focused on preserving and actively reconnecting fragmented natural habitats, is absolutely essential. Ultimately, protecting biological diversity is not merely a philanthropic endeavor for wildlife conservation; it is an urgent prerequisite for ensuring the long-term stability and resilience of human food systems and global public health.

items.title: The Gig Economy

en.0: "for parents or students that flexibility is genuinely valuable".
en.1: Rejected — the speaker calls income volatility a cost, not an acceptable trade.
en.2: "classified as independent contractors, which removes access to paid leave, sick pay and pension".
en.3: Never stated; the speaker seeks reform, not abolition.

items.audio: The gig economy is often celebrated as a symbol of freedom, but the picture is more nuanced. Many workers value setting their own hours, and for parents or students that flexibility is genuinely valuable. However, the same irregularity that provides freedom also produces income volatility, since there is no guarantee of work from one week to the next. Crucially, gig workers are usually classified as independent contractors, which removes access to paid leave, sick pay and employer pension contributions. My own view is that flexibility has real worth, but not when it is used as a pretext to shift the entire burden of social protection onto the individual.
items.question: You will hear a recording. It plays ONLY ONCE. Choose the TWO statements that reflect the speaker’s view.
options: The speaker believes flexibility is genuinely valuable for some workers.
The speaker thinks irregular hours are an acceptable trade for freedom.
The speaker notes that contractor status removes access to social protections.
The speaker argues the gig economy should be abolished immediately.
The speaker claims income volatility is rare among gig workers.

zh.p: 听说话人观点（多选，倒扣分）
zh.a: 选 A、C。A 对应 "for parents or students that flexibility is genuinely valuable"；C 对应 "classified as independent contractors, which removes access to paid leave, sick pay and employer pension"。
o: 正确：原话 genuinely valuable。
错误：说话人把收入波动当作代价（income volatility），并没有认为可以接受。
正确：contractor 身份失去社会保障。
错误：说话人想改革，从没说要立即废除（abolished immediately 太极端）。
错误：原文 no guarantee of work，波动是常态，不是 rare。
zh.t: 听力多选边听边记关键词：However、Crucially、My own view 后面是观点重点；极端词选项基本可以排除。

zh.p: 听写拼写 + 所有格
zh.a: others' / replacing / acknowledged。

merely ___ a few words：merely 后接动名词 replacing（只是替换几个词）。
When sources are not ___：被动语态 are not acknowledged（未注明出处）。注意双写 ck 和 -ed 结尾。
zh.t: 听力填空拼写错误直接不得分；被动语态的 -ed 和复数 -s 最容易漏，写完要检查语法。

zh.a: storage / demand / expensive。

en.1: Captures all four points and the emphasised social finding.
en.2: Contradicted by "up to four degrees" and no cost criticism is made.
en.3: Contradicted — temperature, drainage and wellbeing were all measured.

items.audio: Cities across Europe have begun inserting green corridors — strips of parkland, tree-lined avenues and restored riverbanks — between dense neighbourhoods. Early evaluations show that these corridors lower street-level temperatures by up to four degrees, reduce stormwater runoff that would otherwise overwhelm drains, and give pollinating insects a continuous route through the built environment. The most important finding, however, was social: residents living within three hundred metres of a green corridor reported markedly higher life satisfaction and were more likely to know their neighbours.
items.question: You will hear a recording. It plays ONLY ONCE. Choose the summary that best represents what you heard.
options: European cities plant green corridors mainly to reduce stormwater costs, and the social benefits were found to be minimal.
Green corridors lower temperatures, ease drainage and help pollinators, but the standout finding was improved resident wellbeing and social connection.
Green corridors are too expensive to justify, since tree-lined avenues cool streets by only a degree or two.
Pollinating insects are the only measurable beneficiaries of the green corridors evaluated across Europe.

zh.p: 选总结：要点完整 + 重点不能偏
zh.a: 选 B。录音列举了降温、排水、传粉昆虫三个好处，然后用 "The most important finding, however, was social" 强调社交和幸福感。B 是唯一既覆盖所有要点、又把重点放在社会效益上的选项。
o: 错误：把“社会效益最重要”说成了“微不足道”，重点反了。
正确：四个要点齐全，重点正确。
错误：原文说降温最多 4 度，也没批评成本。
错误：only 太绝对，温度、排水、幸福感都有测量。
zh.t: HCS 先听 however / most important 引出的重点；只说对一部分或带 only 的选项通常是错的。

items.title: Deep Sea Mining

en.1: Balances the acknowledged resource need against "damage that lasts centuries" and the recycling alternative.
en.2: Never questioned — metals are called essential.

items.audio: Deep sea mining is promoted as the answer to our shortage of cobalt and nickel, both of which are essential for electric vehicle batteries. The seabed does indeed contain enormous polymetallic nodules rich in these metals. The difficulty is that we know very little about abyssal ecosystems, and harvesting them may cause damage that lasts centuries. Some geologists argue that land-based recycling of existing batteries could supply a large share of demand instead, which would avoid disturbing the ocean floor altogether.
items.question: You will hear a recording. It plays ONLY ONCE. Choose the ONE statement that best reflects the speaker’s position.
options: The speaker fully supports deep sea mining because nodules contain abundant metals.
The speaker is cautious, arguing that poorly understood ecosystems and viable recycling alternatives argue against proceeding.
The speaker believes electric vehicles do not actually require cobalt or nickel.
The speaker thinks abyssal ecosystems would recover within a few years of mining.

zh.p: 判断说话人态度
zh.a: 选 B。说话人先承认海底确实有金属（does indeed contain），然后用 "The difficulty is" 转折，指出生态破坏可能持续数百年，并提到回收电池可以替代。整体是谨慎、偏反对。
o: 错误：The difficulty is 之后明显有保留，不是 fully supports。
正确：概括了“不了解生态 + 有回收替代方案”两点。
错误：原文说这两种金属是 essential，从未质疑。
错误：原文说破坏 may last centuries，不是几年。
zh.t: 态度题抓 indeed（让步）和 The difficulty is（转折），转折后才是说话人的真实立场。

items.model: Governments face a persistent choice between widening roads and improving public transport, and I largely favour the latter because rail and bus networks move more people through the same space while producing far lower emissions per passenger. Building additional road capacity frequently fails to ease congestion, a phenomenon known as induced demand: whenever a route becomes faster, more drivers choose it until the advantage disappears. Public transport avoids this trap, since a single metro line can carry tens of thousands of travellers each hour without expanding the footprint of the city. There are, admittedly, cases where road works are justified, particularly on rural routes where no viable alternative exists. Even so, the balance of spending should favour reliable, frequent and affordable public services. In conclusion, while some road investment remains necessary, prioritising public transport delivers cleaner air, shorter commutes and more equitable access to employment.

items.title: Urban Green Spaces (Single-Sentence Drill)
items.model: Although rapid urban development constantly threatens metropolitan green spaces, preserving parks and vegetation remains essential because they deliver vital ecological cooling, reduce airborne pollutants, and significantly enhance public health.
items.text: Urban green spaces, such as public parks, community gardens, and tree-lined avenues, provide indispensable ecological and psychological benefits to city dwellers. Ecologically, these vegetated areas mitigate the urban heat island effect by cooling ambient air through evapotranspiration and shading impervious surfaces. Furthermore, urban vegetation absorbs carbon dioxide, filters particulate pollutants, and mitigates stormwater runoff during intense precipitation events. From a public health perspective, regular exposure to nature within metropolitan environments has been shown to reduce psychological stress, encourage physical exercise, and foster community cohesion. Despite these documented advantages, rapid urban development frequently encroaches upon existing green spaces, leading urban planners to advocate for compulsory green infrastructure quotas in contemporary municipal zoning policies. Economically, the presence of well-maintained green spaces often drives up local property values and attracts tourism, thereby boosting the municipal tax base. Cities that invest heavily in extensive park networks frequently observe a high return on investment due to the corresponding influx of highly skilled workers seeking an improved quality of life. Consequently, preserving urban vegetation is not only an environmental and health imperative, but also a cornerstone of robust economic urban planning.

items.title: Remote Working (Grammar & Form Reset: 220–250 Words)
items.model: In recent years, remote working has emerged as a standard practice across various industries, offering considerable benefits alongside notable challenges. The most significant advantage of working from home is the improvement in work-life balance and the elimination of daily commuting. Without spending hours travelling to offices, employees can allocate more time to their personal well-being and families, while also saving substantial transportation costs. In addition, many professionals report higher productivity in home environments where office distractions and impromptu interruptions are minimized. However, remote working presents certain drawbacks that cannot be ignored. The blurring of boundaries between professional responsibilities and personal life often leads to longer working hours and employee burnout. Furthermore, virtual communication can impede spontaneous collaboration and weaken team cohesion, which is essential for creative problem-solving. In conclusion, although remote employment poses challenges related to isolation and boundaries, its benefits in flexibility and time savings outweigh these concerns when managed effectively.

en.B: Independent topic sentence establishing communication prior to the 17th century.
en.D: Direct link: "This informal method of correspondence" refers back to personal letters in B.
en.A: Direct link: "These early periodicals" refers to the scientific journals mentioned in D.
en.C: Conclusion: "Today, this system..." brings the historical evolution to modern times.

paras: These early periodicals allowed researchers across Europe to debate findings and scrutinize experimental methods collaboratively.
Before the seventeenth century, scientific knowledge was primarily communicated through personal letters between individual scholars.
Today, this system of peer-reviewed publication has evolved into a global digital network of thousands of specialized academic journals.
This informal method of correspondence changed dramatically in 1665 with the founding of the first official scientific journals in London and Paris.

zh.p: 代词链 + 时间顺序
zh.a: 顺序 B → D → A → C。B 交代 17 世纪以前的背景，独立开头；D 的 This informal method of correspondence 指 B 的 personal letters；A 的 These early periodicals 指 D 的 scientific journals；C 用 Today 收尾。
o: A：These early periodicals 回指 D。
B：没有代词，Before the seventeenth century 交代背景，开头。
C：Today, this system，时间最晚，结尾。
D：This informal method 回指 B，并引出 1665 年的期刊。
zh.t: 画出“代词链”：letters → this informal method → journals → these periodicals → this system，一环扣一环。

B：宏观背景，开头。
C：结果，放最后。
D：this question 回指 B。
zh.t: 学术段落常见结构：背景/问题 → 采取行动 → 细节 → 结果。先排开头和结尾，中间靠代词配对。

items.title: Urbanisation and migration
items.audio: Today I want to talk about how urbanisation is reshaping patterns of human migration in the twenty-first century. For most of human history, people moved primarily from rural to urban areas within their own country. But that pattern is changing. We're now seeing increased movement between cities across national borders, often driven by economic opportunity, climate pressures, and digital connectivity. Researchers estimate that by 2050, around two-thirds of the world's population will live in cities. This shift has significant implications for housing, infrastructure, and social cohesion. Megacities in Asia and Africa are growing fastest, while many cities in Europe and North America are seeing slower or even negative growth. Understanding these flows is essential for policymakers planning the next generation of urban infrastructure.

items.title: The placebo effect in clinical trials
items.audio: The placebo effect is one of the most fascinating phenomena in medicine. When patients receive an inactive treatment they believe to be real, they often experience genuine improvements in their symptoms. This isn't simply imagination — measurable physiological changes occur. In clinical trials, researchers use placebo-controlled designs to separate the genuine effect of a drug from the patient's expectations. What's interesting is that the strength of the placebo effect has increased over time, particularly in trials of pain medications and antidepressants conducted in the United States. This makes drug development more difficult. Some researchers argue that ritual, expectation, and the therapeutic relationship itself are powerful drivers of healing — components that traditional medicine sometimes overlooks.

items.title: Microplastics in the food chain
items.audio: Microplastics — particles smaller than five millimetres — are now found in virtually every corner of the planet, from deep ocean sediment to mountain snow. They enter the environment from the breakdown of larger plastic items, from synthetic textile fibres released in laundry, and from tyre wear on roads. Once in the environment, these particles are ingested by marine organisms, working their way up the food chain. Studies have detected microplastics in seafood, table salt, drinking water, and human blood. The health implications are still being investigated, but early research suggests possible links to inflammation, hormone disruption, and the transport of toxic chemicals. Reducing plastic production at the source remains the most effective intervention.

items.title: Bilingual brains
items.audio: Research over the past two decades has revealed surprising effects of bilingualism on brain structure and function. People who regularly use two languages appear to develop stronger executive function — the cognitive system responsible for attention, switching between tasks, and ignoring distractions. Imaging studies show denser grey matter in regions associated with language control, and some research suggests that bilingual individuals develop dementia symptoms several years later than monolingual peers, even when the underlying brain pathology is similar. The constant juggling between two language systems appears to act as a form of mental exercise, building cognitive reserves that may protect against age-related decline.

items.title: Soil carbon and farming
items.audio: Agricultural soils contain enormous quantities of carbon, accumulated over thousands of years from decomposed plant matter. Modern intensive farming, with frequent ploughing and bare fallow periods, accelerates the release of this carbon back into the atmosphere as carbon dioxide. Researchers estimate that historical agricultural practices have released roughly a hundred billion tonnes of soil carbon globally. The good news is that this process is partially reversible. Practices such as cover cropping, no-till farming, and integrating livestock can rebuild soil carbon levels, simultaneously improving soil fertility, water retention, and climate outcomes. Some governments are now exploring payments to farmers for measured increases in soil carbon, though the verification methods remain technically challenging.

items.text: Honeybees are facing a global decline that has alarmed scientists, farmers, and conservationists. The phenomenon, known as colony collapse disorder, involves worker bees abandoning their hives, leaving the queen and immature bees behind. Researchers have identified multiple contributing factors rather than a single cause. Among these are widespread use of neonicotinoid pesticides, which impair bee navigation and immune function; loss of wildflower habitat due to intensive agriculture; the spread of the parasitic Varroa mite; and climate change, which disrupts the synchronisation between flowering plants and pollinator activity. Because bees pollinate roughly a third of the food crops humans rely on, including fruits, vegetables, nuts, and oilseeds, their decline threatens both biodiversity and food security. Some governments have responded by restricting certain pesticides and incentivising the planting of pollinator-friendly hedgerows along farm boundaries, while urban beekeeping has gained popularity as a way to support local populations. However, experts caution that piecemeal measures are unlikely to reverse the trend, and that a coordinated, landscape-scale response is needed.

The rapid growth of e-commerce has transformed retail logistics and reshaped urban environments in ways few predicted a decade ago. Consumers in major cities now expect same-day or next-day delivery as standard, which has driven retailers and platforms to build dense networks of warehouses, sorting centres, and last-mile distribution hubs on the urban fringe. These facilities require thousands of workers, many in precarious employment, and they generate substantial truck and van traffic that adds to local air pollution and road congestion. At the same time, the convenience offered by online shopping has accelerated the decline of brick-and-mortar retail, with vacancy rates on traditional high streets rising in many countries. Some city governments are responding by zoning new logistics facilities away from residential areas, encouraging cargo bikes for the final delivery leg, and offering grants to repurpose vacant retail space for housing, services, or community uses. Whether these measures can offset the broader disruption remains an open question, as the underlying consumer behaviour shows no sign of reversing.

Artificial intelligence systems based on large language models are being rapidly integrated into education, raising both opportunities and concerns among teachers, parents, and policymakers. Advocates argue that these tools can offer personalised tutoring at scale, helping students work through difficult material at their own pace and providing instant feedback on writing assignments. They can also free teachers from routine tasks like marking, allowing more time for one-on-one engagement. Critics, however, point to several risks. Students may use AI tools to bypass the cognitive effort required for genuine learning, particularly for writing assignments where the process of drafting is itself the educational goal. There are also concerns about the accuracy of AI outputs, which can confidently present incorrect information, and about the equity implications when access to high-quality tools depends on a family's ability to pay for premium services. Schools are now navigating these tensions through new policies, often combining outright bans in some contexts with structured integration in others, while assessment formats are shifting to emphasise in-class oral examinations and supervised practical work.

items.text: The transition to renewable energy is reshaping global labour markets in unexpected ways. While employment in coal and oil sectors has declined sharply over the past decade, jobs in solar, wind, and battery manufacturing have grown rapidly, particularly in regions that have invested in domestic supply chains. However, the new jobs are not always located where the old jobs disappear, and the skill profiles often differ significantly. Workers displaced from extractive industries frequently require retraining, and many local economies built around a single dominant employer struggle to attract replacement investment quickly. Policymakers in several countries have responded with targeted transition funds, although the scale and effectiveness of these programmes vary widely.
items.question: Which statements about the energy transition are supported by the passage?
options: Renewable energy jobs are growing faster than fossil fuel jobs are declining.
Displaced fossil fuel workers can easily move into renewable energy roles.
New renewable energy jobs are not always in the same locations as the lost jobs.
Retraining is often necessary for workers transitioning between sectors.
Government transition funds have uniformly succeeded across countries.

zh.p: 细节判断 + 识别“无法比较”的陷阱
zh.a: 选 C、D。C 对应 "the new jobs are not always located where the old jobs disappear"；D 对应 "Workers displaced from extractive industries frequently require retraining"。
o: 错误：原文只说两边一个下降、一个增长，没有比较速度，属于“原文没说”。
错误：原文说 skill profiles often differ，需要再培训，easily 与原文相反。
正确：not always located where ... 的同义改写。
正确：frequently require retraining = often necessary。
错误：原文说 vary widely（差别很大），uniformly succeeded 相反。
zh.t: 原文没有给出比较的数据时，选项里的 faster than / more than 通常是陷阱。

items.text: Sleep is increasingly recognised as a foundational pillar of physical and mental health. Studies consistently associate insufficient sleep with elevated risks of cardiovascular disease, obesity, impaired immune function, and depression. The mechanisms involve hormonal disruption, including changes to cortisol and insulin sensitivity, as well as reduced clearance of metabolic waste from brain tissue. Despite this growing body of evidence, average sleep duration has declined in many industrialised societies, driven by longer working hours, increased screen use, and irregular schedules. Public health campaigns have begun to emphasise sleep alongside diet and exercise, although awareness remains lower than for those more traditional pillars of health.
items.question: Which statements are supported by the passage?
options: Lack of sleep is linked to multiple chronic conditions.
Sleep deprivation only affects mental health, not physical health.
Average sleep duration has increased over recent decades.
Hormonal changes are one mechanism through which sleep loss affects health.
Sleep is now treated as more important than diet in public health campaigns.

zh.p: 细节判断 + 反义陷阱
zh.a: 选 A、D。A 对应 "insufficient sleep with elevated risks of cardiovascular disease, obesity ... depression"（多种慢性病）；D 对应 "The mechanisms involve hormonal disruption"。
o: 正确：列举了心血管病、肥胖等多种疾病。
错误：only mental 与原文同时提到身体疾病矛盾。
错误：原文说 has declined，不是 increased。
正确：hormonal disruption 是机制之一。
错误：原文说 alongside diet（并列），且认知度更低，不是 more important。
zh.t: alongside = 并列，不是“更重要”；increase / decline 这类方向词要和原文逐一核对。

items.text: While many people associate creativity with sudden flashes of insight, research suggests that most creative breakthroughs are the result of long periods of careful, often tedious preparation. Domain expertise, deliberate practice, and exposure to a wide range of ideas all contribute to the conditions under which a novel solution can emerge. The moment of insight, when it comes, is best understood as the visible peak of a much larger hidden process.

zh.p: 主旨题：While 让步结构
zh.a: 选 B。While many people associate creativity with sudden flashes 是让步（大众观点），research suggests 后面才是作者观点：突破来自 long periods of careful preparation，B 是同义改写。

正确：sustained preparation and practice = long periods of careful preparation + deliberate practice。
错误：原文完全没提天赋。

zh.t: While / Although 开头的句子，前半句通常是要被推翻的观点，答案在后半句。

items.title: Urban green spaces
items.audio: Recent research on urban planning has highlighted the significant role that green spaces play in city health. Parks, street trees, and community gardens not only improve air quality and reduce urban temperatures during heat waves, but also support mental health by providing places for relaxation and informal social contact. Studies in several European cities have shown measurable reductions in rates of anxiety and depression among residents living within walking distance of substantial green space. However, the distribution of these benefits is often uneven, with lower-income neighbourhoods having significantly less access. Planners are increasingly trying to address this imbalance, though competing pressures for housing and commercial development can make new green space difficult to create.

错误：犯罪率没有提到。
正确：support mental health，并提到焦虑、抑郁减少。
正确：reduce urban temperatures during heat waves。
错误：房产税收入没有提到。
zh.t: 列举类信息出现时（not only ... but also），快速记下每一项的首字母或关键词。

items.title: Tidal energy
items.audio: Tidal energy is among the most predictable forms of renewable power, since tide cycles can be forecast accurately for decades in advance. Despite this advantage, tidal generation has scaled much more slowly than solar or wind. The main barriers are the high cost of building structures that can withstand the marine environment, the limited number of suitable coastal sites, and the environmental impact on local ecosystems. Recent prototypes using floating turbines suggest there may be room for cost reduction, but tidal energy is unlikely to become a major component of the global energy mix in the next decade.
items.question: What is the main reason tidal energy has scaled slowly?
options: Tides are too unpredictable to rely on.
Costs and site limitations have held back deployment.
Tidal turbines cannot generate enough power to be useful.
Most coastal countries have banned tidal generation.

zh.p: 原因题
zh.a: 选 B。录音明确说 "The main barriers are the high cost of building structures ... the limited number of suitable coastal sites"。
o: 错误：录音开头就说潮汐是 most predictable，可预测性正是它的优势。
正确：成本高 + 合适的选址有限。
错误：没说发电量不够。
错误：没提禁止。
zh.t: 问 main reason 时，直接等 The main barriers / The main reason 这类信号词。

items.title: Plastic recycling
items.audio: Despite decades of public messaging about recycling, the global recycling rate for plastic remains stubbornly low — under ten percent according to most estimates. The reasons are partly technical: many plastics are chemically incompatible, contamination from food residue ruins entire batches, and recycled plastic often has degraded properties that limit its use. The reasons are also economic: virgin plastic, derived from cheap oil, has consistently undercut recycled material on price. Researchers and policymakers increasingly argue that reducing plastic production at the source — through bans on single-use items, refill systems, and material substitutions — must be a higher priority than expanding recycling infrastructure.
items.question: Which summary best matches the recording?
options: Plastic recycling rates are low because of technical and economic challenges, leading experts to argue that reducing plastic production should be prioritised over recycling.
Plastic recycling is highly successful globally, with most plastic being recovered and reused thanks to consumer awareness campaigns.
The main reason plastic recycling fails is that consumers are unwilling to participate in recycling programmes despite public messaging.
Most countries have already banned single-use plastics and built large recycling networks, which have solved the plastic waste problem.

zh.p: 选总结：原因 + 结论都要有
zh.a: 选 A。录音结构是：回收率低 → 技术原因 → 经济原因 → 专家主张从源头减产。A 是唯一把原因和结论都覆盖的选项。
o: 正确：技术 + 经济原因，加上优先减产的结论。
错误：原文说回收率不到 10%，与 highly successful 相反。
错误：原因是技术和经济问题，不是消费者不愿意参与。
错误：原文没说问题已经解决。
zh.t: HCS 选项通常一个“完整正确”、几个“部分正确或相反”；比较时看谁覆盖了结论句。

items.title: Volcanic eruptions
items.audio: Predicting when a volcano will erupt is one of the most difficult challenges in geology. While monitoring of earthquakes, gas emissions, and ground deformation can indicate that a volcano is becoming active, the precise timing remains hard to forecast. This uncertainty makes evacuation decisions extremely difficult for local
items.question: Which word best completes the recording?
options: authorities
tourists
scientists
students

zh.p: 根据上下文预测最后一个词
zh.a: 选 authorities。evacuation decisions（疏散决定）是由“地方当局”做出的，local authorities 也是高频搭配。
o: 正确：local authorities 做疏散决策。
错误：游客不做疏散决定。
错误：科学家负责预测，不负责疏散决策。
错误：与语境无关。
zh.t: SMW 不需要听清最后一个词，要听懂主题和逻辑：谁会受影响 / 谁做决定。local authorities 是固定搭配。

items.title: Vaccine development
items.audio: Developing a new vaccine traditionally takes ten to fifteen years, involving multiple phases of testing for safety and effectiveness. The rapid development of COVID vaccines was possible because researchers had been working on related coronaviruses for years and because regulatory processes were accelerated without compromising safety
items.question: Which word best completes the recording?
options: standards
concerns
agencies
documents

zh.p: 固定搭配预测
zh.a: 选 standards。without compromising safety standards（不降低安全标准）是固定搭配，前文也强调了 safety and effectiveness。
o: 正确：compromise safety standards。
错误：compromising safety concerns 逻辑不通。
错误：agencies 是机构，不能被 compromise。
错误：documents 语义无关。
zh.t: 常见搭配：compromise safety standards / quality standards；听到 compromising safety 时就可以预判。

paras: The discovery of antibiotics in the early twentieth century transformed medicine, turning infections that were once routinely fatal into easily treatable conditions.
Initially, these new drugs were celebrated as a near-miraculous victory over bacterial disease, and their use expanded rapidly through both medicine and agriculture.
Over decades, however, the overuse and misuse of antibiotics created strong selection pressure on bacterial populations, driving the emergence of resistant strains.
Today, antimicrobial resistance is one of the most serious threats facing global public health, with some infections again becoming difficult or impossible to treat.

zh.p: 时间信号词
zh.a: 顺序 A → B → C → D。A 讲 20 世纪初的发现；B 的 Initially 和 these new drugs 承接 A；C 的 Over decades, however 写转折；D 的 Today 收尾。
o: A：交代事件起点，开头。
B：Initially + these new drugs 回指 A。
C：Over decades, however 转折到滥用。
D：Today，结尾。
zh.t: 时间线信号词：early twentieth century → Initially → Over decades → Today。

paras: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity using the photovoltaic effect, in which photons knock electrons loose from atoms in a semiconductor material.
Early panels in the 1970s were extremely expensive and inefficient, limiting their use to specialised applications such as satellites and remote installations.
Decades of research, manufacturing improvements, and supportive policy have driven costs down by more than ninety percent, making solar competitive with fossil fuel generation in many markets.
As a result, solar capacity has become the fastest-growing source of new electricity generation worldwide, with deployment expected to accelerate through the coming decade.

zh.p: 定义 → 历史 → 发展 → 结果
zh.a: 顺序 A → B → C → D。A 给出太阳能板的定义，是开头；B 讲 1970 年代早期的情况；C 讲几十年来成本下降；D 用 As a result 引出结果。
o: A：定义句，开头。
B：Early panels in the 1970s，历史。
C：Decades of research，发展过程。
D：As a result，结果，必须在原因之后。
zh.t: 定义句通常是第一句；As a result / Therefore 开头的句子永远不可能是第一句。

segs: The development of modern transportation systems has profoundly
urban growth. Cities that grew around rail networks tend to have
centres, while those built around the automobile spread outwards in low-density

interaction.

zh.p: 纯词性题（四个选项是同一个词根）
zh.a: shaped / denser / suburbs / social。
o: has profoundly ___：现在完成时 has + 过去分词，shaped。
tend to have ___ centres：修饰名词要用形容词，与 low-density 对比用比较级 denser。
spread outwards in low-density ___：low-density 修饰名词，复数 suburbs。
energy use and ___ interaction：修饰 interaction 用形容词 social。
zh.t: 四个选项同词根时只看语法位置：has + 过去分词、形容词 + 名词、副词修饰动词。

segs: Recent advances in genetic research have
our understanding of inherited disease. Scientists are now able to
specific mutations responsible for conditions that were once considered untreatable, opening new

zh.p: 纯词性题
zh.a: transformed / identify / avenues。
o: have ___ our understanding：have + 过去分词 transformed。
are now able to ___：to 后接动词原形 identify。
opening new ___ for therapy：new 修饰复数名词 avenues（途径），open new avenues for 是固定搭配。avenger、averages 是形近干扰词。
zh.t: be able to + 动词原形；open up new avenues for sth 是学术写作高频表达，可直接用在作文里。

segs: The growing popularity of remote work has changed how companies
their workforce. Many organisations have adopted flexible
that allow employees to work from home several days a week, reducing the need for large office
in city centres. While productivity gains have been reported in some studies, others highlight challenges around team cohesion and

zh.p: 搭配 + 词性 + 排除干扰词
zh.a: manage / arrangements / spaces / collaboration。
o: how companies ___ their workforce：主语 companies 后接动词原形，manage workforce。controlled 时态不对。
adopted flexible ___：flexible working arrangements（灵活办公安排）是固定搭配。
large office ___ in city centres：office spaces（办公空间）。buildings 也说得通，但 office spaces 与 reducing the need 搭配更自然。
team cohesion and ___：与 cohesion 并列的名词 collaboration（协作）。
zh.t: 词库里会多给几个干扰词：先用语法排除，再用搭配挑最自然的那个。

segs: Effective language learning depends on
exposure rather than occasional intensive study. Learners who engage with the target language
— through reading, listening, conversation, and writing — generally make faster
than those who rely on textbooks alone.

zh.p: 对比逻辑 rather than
zh.a: consistent / daily / progress。
o: depends on ___ exposure rather than occasional intensive study：与 occasional 对比的形容词 consistent（持续的）。
engage with the target language ___：修饰动词用副词，daily 可以作副词（每天）。weekly 也是副词，但与 consistent 的语义更不贴。
make faster ___：make progress 是固定搭配。regression 意思相反。
zh.t: A rather than B，A 与 B 是反义；make progress 是必背搭配。

items.title: Coffee production
items.audio: Coffee is grown primarily in tropical regions along a belt near the equator. Brazil remains the largest producer globally, followed by Vietnam, Colombia, and Indonesia. The crop is highly sensitive to temperature and rainfall, and climate change is already shifting the areas where high-quality coffee can be cultivated. Many smallholder farmers face difficult choices about whether to adapt their practices, move to higher altitudes, or abandon coffee altogether.
segs: Coffee is grown primarily in
regions along a belt near the equator. Brazil remains the largest producer globally, followed by
, Colombia, and Indonesia. The crop is highly sensitive to temperature and
, and climate change is already shifting the areas where high-quality coffee can be cultivated.

zh.p: 听写 + 专有名词拼写
zh.a: tropical / Vietnam / rainfall。
o: in ___ regions along a belt near the equator：赤道附近是 tropical regions。
followed by ___, Colombia, and Indonesia：国家名 Vietnam，首字母大写。
sensitive to temperature and ___：与 temperature 并列的气候要素 rainfall。
zh.t: 专有名词首字母要大写；与 temperature 并列的通常是 rainfall / humidity 这类气候词。

items.title: Renewable energy growth
items.audio: The growth of renewable energy capacity worldwide has been driven primarily by sharp reductions in the cost of solar panels and wind turbines over the past decade.
items.display: The growth of renewable energy capacity globally has been driven primarily by sharp reductions in the price of solar panels and wind machines over the past decade.

zh.p: 找出录音与文字不一致的词
zh.a: 共 3 处不同：globally（录音是 worldwide）、price（录音是 cost）、machines（录音是 turbines）。
o: globally → 录音说 worldwide。
price → 录音说 cost。
machines → 录音说 turbines。
zh.t: HIW 每点错一个扣一分；眼睛跟着录音逐词移动，只点你确定不一样的词。替换词通常是同义词，所以要听“音”，不要只听“意思”。
